info.title: SignalMe
info.description: A resident presence runtime for Luxafor USB LED devices. Runs in your terminal, shows your availability status, plays expressive light signals, and switches the device to away by itself while your Windows session is locked. Windows only.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: A resident presence runtime for Luxafor devices.

options.name: --mode
options.description:
Where the status comes from. Default: manual.
Available modes: manual.

options.name: --version
options.description:
Prints the version.
Once SignalMe runs, type 'help' at its prompt for the commands it understands.
